description: A young girl with a long dark braid, wearing a dark pinafore, leans over a wooden table and spoons soup from a bowl, steam rising. Other children sit at the same table with bowls in front of them, and one bowl sits on the table near the foreground. A woman in a white cap and apron stands at the right, ladling from a large metal pot. The room is plain, with tall windows, bare walls and a wall-mounted oil lamp, and the scene is painted in muted greys and browns. No legible text. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
reason: Shows a European-style soup kitchen with children eating from bowls, not the Busoga kingdoms of eastern Uganda in 1400. The pinafores, white cap and multi-pane windows read as 19th-century European, not a 1400 East African setting.
